title: Tag issue author in automated pre-review comments
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt: Prepends an @mention of the issue author (from the already-validated metadata.githubUsername) to the automated pre-review comments, so submitters get notified when the bot comments on their issue.

gist.headline: The bot knows who called
gist.blurb: Pre-review comments now tap the original submitter on the shoulder. The hive's little paperwork bee has learned notifications.
gist.summary: The automated ingestion pre-review agent now prepends an @mention from validated metadata.githubUsername, notifying the issue author when it leaves a review comment.
gist.impact: Contributors will receive GitHub notifications for automated pre-review feedback instead of having to discover the comment on their own.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny pre-review clerk in a cozy garden-shed hackerspace, carefully attaching an @mention tag to a glowing code-review letter addressed to a contributor. A small CRT monitor robot can hold the letter while code-plants and flowers establish the open-source garden setting.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-shed hackerspace where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian visor, attaches a glowing '@author' tag to a code-review letter held by a cheerful CRT monitor robot. Lime green (#ecf874) glows from the terminal and code-plants bloom around them; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: 'YOU'VE BEEN MENTIONED'.
